newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates down in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates down in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound slipped in a very liquid private-sector market on Monday to between seven and eight percent from between eight and 9-1/4 percent on Sunday, bankers said.
All bankers said they did not deal one-week. "Everyone is offering one-week," one banker said. On Sunday, bankers quoted one-week rates at between 8-1/2 and 9-3/4 percent.
"It (the reason) is accumulating liquidity," another banker said. "There are not enough products on the market. The inflation rate will go up if this liquidity remains for long.
"This situation will lead to either a return to dollarisation or the transformation (of funds) into real estate and the like, pushing prices up,"the banker added.
Public-sector banks kept their rates at 10-1/2 percent.
